usage: Propositions uniquement, aucune intégration au jeu
consigne_commune: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished transparent character sprite concept sheet for a French satirical 2D political game. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: reference 1 is a civilian NPC; reference 2 is a character animation sheet. Match their hand-drawn cartoon game art, large expressive heads, compact adult bodies, dark ink outlines, warm painted cel shading, slightly caricatured proportions, 3/4 side view at ground level. Do not copy the reference characters. Subject: one MALE camera journalist and one FEMALE microphone journalist, both clearly about 30-35 years old. They pursue a candidate to interview him: the camera operator tracks the candidate at short range while filming, the reporter thrusts her microphone toward the candidate in a close-range poking attack. No candidate drawn. Make a clean landscape sheet exactly TWO ROWS and SIX COLUMNS, 12 isolated complete full-body figures, equal cell sizes, generous transparent gaps, no overlap, every shoe and every accessory fully inside each cell. TOP ROW: the SAME male camera journalist in six poses from left to right: 1 neutral ready holding camera low, 2 walking right left foot forward, 3 walking right right foot forward, 4 raising camera to shoulder, 5 filming steadily toward right with braced legs, 6 filming while taking a tracking step right. BOTTOM ROW: the SAME female journalist in six poses: 1 neutral holding microphone near chest, 2 walking right left foot forward, 3 walking right right foot forward, 4 preparation with microphone drawn back, 5 clear close-range attack thrusting microphone horizontally to the right at chest height with fully extended arm and a forward step, 6 retracting microphone after thrust. Maintain strict identity, outfit, head size, anatomy, microphone design and camera design across all six poses of each character. Whole-body consistent scale and foot baseline per row. A single coherent real shoulder-mounted TV video camera with lens pointing right and hands correctly gripping it; a handheld wireless microphone with black foam head. Readable compact silhouettes at small game scale. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no environment, no captions or text, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no attack cone, no laser, no rays, no blood. This is a design proposal with movement and attack key poses, not a finished guaranteed animation atlas.
variantes: Variant 1: everyday field news duo. Man: short brown slightly tousled hair, light stubble, olive utility jacket over pale T-shirt, blue jeans, dark sneakers. Woman: chestnut shoulder-length hair tied in a short ponytail, red casual jacket over cream blouse, dark fitted trousers and flat ankle boots. Determined lively expressions, practical contemporary French street clothes.

Variant 2: polished city news duo. Man: short curly black hair, medium brown skin, trimmed beard, navy casual jacket, grey T-shirt, charcoal chinos, practical sneakers. Woman: light skin, chin-length blonde bob, ochre blazer over white top, navy trousers, comfortable flat shoes. About 32 years old, focused and insistent rather than angry.

Variant 3: mobile street reporting duo. Man: light skin, auburn short hair and short beard, slate-blue rolled-sleeve overshirt over beige T-shirt, dark jeans, sturdy trainers. Woman: medium brown skin, dark curly hair tied high with a few curls framing face, teal-green field jacket, light grey top, dark burgundy trousers, practical sneakers. About 30-35, energetic expressions. No hats.
comportement_prevu: Arrivée par le bas comme les PNJ. Le duo poursuit un candidat ayant trop d’avance. Le cadreur ralentit le candidat tant que sa caméra le filme dans sa zone de courte portée. La journaliste inflige des dégâts au corps à corps en tendant le micro.
limites: Planches de propositions : poses clés, pas une animation complète validée. Les pas générés sont parfois très proches ; compléter une vraie alternance des jambes avant intégration. Découpage, orientations et raccords à préparer après choix de la variante.
